zh: 忽略大小写后，每一次换字母都恰好对应相邻两个字符不同的一个位置。
把相邻两个字符都转成小写再比较，只要不同就计数一次，从头到尾扫描一遍即可。
读入字符串 s，答案为 0；对 i 从 1 到长度减 1，若 s[i] 与 s[i−1] 转成小写后不同则答案加 1；输出答案。
en: Ignoring case, every letter change corresponds to exactly one position where two adjacent characters differ.
Compare each pair of adjacent characters in lowercase and count one whenever they differ; a single scan from start to end does it.
Read the string s and start the answer at 0. For i from 1 to length - 1, add 1 if the lowercase forms of s[i] and s[i - 1] differ. Print the answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Scan the lowercase forms of adjacent characters and add 1 whenever they differ.

## Correctness

Each change of letter between key presses corresponds to exactly one adjacent position with different characters, so counting position by position neither repeats nor misses anything.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(1).
